paragraphs: Without limiting the foregoing, Confidential Information expressly includes all manuscripts and drafts, personal archives, photographs, documents, and audio or video recordings of conversations (including interviews), together with all copies, transcripts, summaries and derivatives of any of them, in any form (“Private Material”), that the Disclosing Party has shared or shares with the Receiving Party, whether before or after the date of this Agreement. The Receiving Party shall use Private Material solely for the purposes of the agreed engagement under the Proposed Transaction and for no other purpose.

new_clauses.title: Use of AI Tools
paragraphs: The Receiving Party shall not upload, input or otherwise submit any Private Material to any artificial intelligence tool, service or platform (including generative AI, transcription and summarisation tools) without the Disclosing Party’s prior written approval, which applies only to the tool and purpose stated in the approval. In no event shall Private Material be used to train, fine-tune or improve any artificial intelligence or machine-learning model, whether by the Receiving Party or any third party.

new_clauses.title: No Reuse of Material
paragraphs: The Receiving Party shall not use, reproduce, reference or disclose the Disclosing Party’s Confidential Information, Private Material, or the content created under the engagement, for any other client, or in any portfolio, case study, testimonial or marketing material, without the Disclosing Party’s prior written approval for each such use. This clause prevails over clause 10 (Independent Development Activities).

new_clauses.title: Ownership of Content
paragraphs: Ownership of, and rights in, the content created by the Receiving Party under the engagement shall be recorded in writing in the service agreement entered into between the Parties for the engagement (the “Service Agreement”). Pending the Service Agreement, nothing in this Agreement transfers or licenses to the Receiving Party any right in the Private Material or other Confidential Information, other than the limited right to use it for the engagement.
